snippet.title: Skyrim: Coven of Crones -  Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Coven of Crones: 
https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/ccbe2c79-9749-41b1-97e0-1097e087d593/Coven_of_Crones
Part of the Bethesda Verified Creators program - Coven of Crones is an exciting new land and quest creation, which explores a secretive plot orchestrated by Anise and her coven of Hags who have settled in a mysterious land once home to druids, but now a cesspool of lost souls doomed to be fodder to the Crones' wicked scheme. 

The player will explore The Blighted Marsh, a Solstheim-sized island encased by raging storms in the Sea of Ghosts. and fight to unravel Anise's plans. The Marsh is home to new custom creatures to slay, professional grade voice acted quests to complete, dungeons to explore, and many additions to aid you in your adventures. 

Key Features - 

. Leave Skyrim, and travel to a remote isle in the Sea of Ghosts to unravel Anise's plot, in a large new quest featuring exciting new characters to meet and multi-stage bosses to fight. 

. New Dungeons, Creatures, Weapons, Spells and more - Find yourself in a strange, hostile land, among new flora and desperate souls, pleading for your help.

. Slay Anise, the Wicked, and claim her home for yourself. Defeat her coven, and tame the undead to act as your New Mount.

.Explore a Solstheim-Sized Island, with high quality level design, custom weathers, lighting, sound design, and a plethora of lore to uncover and learn.
--------------------------------------------

Coven of Crones is out now on PC & Xbox One via the creation menu!
